mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement that records financial activities of a particular business organisation (business enterprise)."
Financial statement is a statement that records financial activities of a particular business organisation (business enterprise).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the operating decisions in the areas of pricing, costing of the volume of output and the firm's product lines selection."
Profit planning is the operating decisions in the areas of pricing, costing of the volume of output and the firm's product lines selection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the acquired roles of the Finance Manager."
Profit-planning function is one of the acquired roles of the Finance Manager.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the expected variability of the income flow."
Risk is the expected variability of the income flow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital organ of a market economy, showing the goods and services required in the community."
Price mechanism (system) is a vital organ of a market economy, showing the goods and services required in the community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the market that serves as an intermediary between fund- raisers and supplier of capital."
The Exchange is the market that serves as an intermediary between fund- raisers and supplier of capital.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the balance of goods on hand (part of current assets)."
Inventories are the balance of goods on hand (part of current assets).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creditor to the firm, therefore, he is entitled to a fixed interest payment whether a firm makes profit or not."
A debenture stock holder is a creditor to the firm, therefore, he is entitled to a fixed interest payment whether a firm makes profit or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the management of current or short-term assets and short-term liabilities."
Working capital management refers to the management of current or short-term assets and short-term liabilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a certificate stating the amount of money lent by a bond holder to the company."
A bond/debenture is a certificate stating the amount of money lent by a bond holder to the company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to provide a cushion or buffer to withstand some unexpected emergency."
Cash at this stage is used to provide a cushion or buffer to withstand some unexpected emergency.
fib: ______ is a process of achieving specified objectives.
Planning
Planning is a process of achieving specified objectives.
______ is used to cast forward the past performance into the future.
Forecasting
Forecasting is used to cast forward the past performance into the future.
______ is an active participant in long -range financial planning.
Treasurer
The Treasurer is an active participant in long -range financial planning.
______ is a tool to avoid excessive and inadequate levels of inventories and maintain sufficient inventory for the smooth operations of the enterprise in terms of production and sales output.
Inventory management

Inventory management is a tool to avoid excessive and inadequate levels of inventories and maintain sufficient inventory for the smooth operations of the enterprise in terms of production and sales output.
______ are called shareholders/stockholders and they are the legal-owners of the business whose shares they hold.
Buyers of shares
Buyers of shares are called shareholders/stockholders and they are the legal-owners of the business whose shares they hold.
______ may be defined as the provision of money at the time it is required.
Finance
Finance may be defined as the provision of money at the time it is required.
______ is the retained portion of profits.
retention ratio
The retention ratio is the retained portion of profits.
______ is the risk which is borne by the seller.
time lag
The time lag is the risk which is borne by the seller.
______ is the common denominator for the full range of activities performed in the business.
Money
Money is the common denominator for the full range of activities performed in the business.
______ is used for two purposes, namely: definitive purpose and information purpose.
Financial statement analysis
Financial statement analysis is used for two purposes, namely: definitive purpose and information purpose.
